findings: No blocking implementation findings.
The change remains within CONTRACT-001 and introduces no product features or prohibited scope.
Clean-placeholder Go tests/build, the full verification script, npm lockfile install, CGO-free Windows cross-build, ignore checks, and diff checks passed.
PR #4 was merged before mandatory review; this post-merge audit cannot restore the missing pre-merge blocking authority, so future PRs must wait for approval.
A transitive deprecated glob package is non-blocking while npm audit reports zero vulnerabilities.
P0: Whole coarse location was mandatory instead of absent/present-disabled/present-enabled, and arbitrary ProfileID values were accepted.
P0: Free-form AdapterConfig map values could carry secrets into domain records and persistence outside CredentialStore.
Revision required typed optional location with LocalProfileID enforcement and typed allowlisted non-secret adapter configuration with regression tests.
Both prior P0 findings are resolved in revision ba5683d.
Whole location now represents absent, present-disabled, and present-enabled states, and profile validation requires LocalProfileID.
Adapter configuration is a typed per-kind sum; raw configuration accepts only allowlisted non-secret keys and rejects representative sensitive or unknown keys.
Dependency inversion, content permission, partial refresh, ranking explanation, credential callback, repository, transaction, ingestion, ranking, and service boundaries remain sound.
Non-blocking: later implementations must sanitize error summaries, avoid retaining callback secret bytes, and validate ranking-result bounds and consistency.
P0: Generated mutation request types omitted required resource path identifiers.
P0: ArticleDetail allowed full content when contentPermission was metadata_only.
P0: SourceWrite allowed mismatched source kinds, adapter configurations, and unsafe enabled-scraper policy states.
P1: Validation was shallow and frontend fixtures were not compiled against generated types.
P1: The endpoint-to-screen coverage matrix was absent and two source reads lacked a compiled handler boundary.
All prior P0 and P1 findings are resolved in revision afe7a85.
Generated operations carry typed path, query, and body inputs with compile-time assertions.
ArticleDetail discriminates permissions and rejects metadata-only content leakage.
SourceWrite discriminates source kind/configuration and enforces approved review metadata for enabled scrapers.
Pinned Redocly validation, constraint-aware fixtures, typed consumers, negative fixtures, endpoint coverage, and compiled SourceQueries boundary passed review.
Optional profile states and typed source adapter/policy states were porous.
Persistent filter state and strict migration history were missing.
Invariant proof was too narrow and Windows verification assumed Python.
Most prior findings were resolved, but normalized ranking values remained unbounded.
Article-source and refresh timestamp ordering remained unenforced.
All earlier findings are resolved at revision 3f73e44.
Ranking values are bounded, timestamps are causally ordered, and all earlier negative probes remain enforcing.
Node sqlite experimental warning is a non-blocking tooling risk.
Non-loopback listener validation occurred after binding.
Health response violated the OpenAPI schema.
Browser readiness probed the SPA root too loosely.
All prior critical/high findings are resolved at revision 483e891.
Pre-listen loopback rejection, exact health output, and strict canonical readiness are covered by enforcing negative tests.
Negative fixtures could fail for unintended reasons because the harness discarded validation issues.
Go response decoding was sparse and permissive rather than family-specific and semantic.
The scraper fixture was not structurally parsed or validated.
All prior P0/P1 findings are resolved at revision 11d11c1.
Exact negative reasons and wrong-reason regression are enforced.
Strict family-specific Go decoding, fixture-derived domain semantics, and structural scraper validation pass.
PowerShell parity was inspected; native execution remains later Windows integration proof.
